scope: Isolated four DskEth cell families/five modes including SN174 PRECAP0/1. Original comparator/counter/setup/clear semantics retained verbatim. Matched50MHz negative-edge external staging/positive-edge launch/capture,20ns embedded paths,2ns max0ns min virtual I/O. Counts include shell/admin/pruning; no behavior change/full board/global snapshot or speed claim.

cell_MC1650.scope:
Pinned local state words for DskEth comparator/counter/TTL FF families.

Caller freezes the whole board before accessing these local words. This does
not implement the board handshake, global barrier or calibrated timers.

expected_qsf.baseline:
set_global_assignment -name FAMILY "Cyclone V"
set_global_assignment -name DEVICE 5CSEBA6U23I7
set_global_assignment -name TOP_LEVEL_ENTITY snapshot_fit
set_global_assignment -name MIN_CORE_JUNCTION_TEMP -40
set_global_assignment -name MAX_CORE_JUNCTION_TEMP 100
set_global_assignment -name TIMEQUEST_MULTICORNER_ANALYSIS OFF
set_global_assignment -name OPTIMIZATION_MODE "HIGH PERFORMANCE EFFORT"
set_global_assignment -name OPTIMIZE_HOLD_TIMING ALL_PATHS
set_global_assignment -name NUM_PARALLEL_PROCESSORS 4
set_global_assignment -name SYSTEMVERILOG_FILE top.sv
set_global_assignment -name SDC_FILE bank.sdc
set_location_assignment PIN_V11 -to host_clk
set_instance_assignment -name IO_STANDARD "3.3-V LVTTL" -to host_clk
set_global_assignment -name SYSTEMVERILOG_FILE cell_MC1650_snapshot.sv
set_global_assignment -name VERILOG_FILE cell_MC1650.v
set_global_assignment -name SYSTEMVERILOG_FILE cell_MC10136_snapshot.sv
set_global_assignment -name VERILOG_FILE cell_MC10136.v
set_global_assignment -name SYSTEMVERILOG_FILE cell_SN74LS169_snapshot.sv
set_global_assignment -name VERILOG_FILE cell_SN74LS169.v
set_global_assignment -name SYSTEMVERILOG_FILE cell_SN74LS174_snapshot.sv
set_global_assignment -name VERILOG_FILE cell_SN74LS174.v
set_instance_assignment -name VIRTUAL_PIN ON -to advance
set_instance_assignment -name VIRTUAL_PIN ON -to hold
set_instance_assignment -name VIRTUAL_PIN ON -to write
